newsitem.title: USA: Beacon Properties buys three properties.
newsitem.headline: Beacon Properties buys three properties.

text.p: Beacon Properties Corp said Monday it has purchased three properties in California and Massachusetts for $253 million.
The company said it also has begun a public offering of six million shares of its common stock which will be used to pay for the acquisitions.

The three properties consist of a 544,000-square-foot ofice tower in West Los Angeles; an 817,000-square-foot, nine-building complex in suburban Boston; and a 263,000-square-foot office building Cambridge, Mass.
Beacon said it plans to use the net proceeds from its offering, along with part of its $300 million credit facility, to finance the acquisitions.
The transactions are expected to be completed during the fourth quarter of the 1996 fiscal year.
Beacon Properties is a self-administered, self-managed real estate investment trust.
